card.name: Digits or 'one' inside lab-term names
card.fires_on: A number or the piece 'one' that sits inside a longer name, such as CD3 3-positive, CYP2D6, or EBV seronegative. It responds on the middle piece, not at the start or end.

modes.label: Inside 'seronegative'
modes.description: The 'one' piece in EBV seronegative, split as ser-one-gative.

modes.label: Digit in a marker or gene name
modes.description: A single digit in CD33 or CYP2D6 style names.

modes.label: Digit in a measurement
modes.description: A digit within a number such as 20 inches in a farming passage.
